source_documents.title: J-Aggregates of BODIPYs: Heat-Induced Fluorescence Enhancement via Polarity-Modulated Photoinduced Electron Transfer

reference_evidence_units.quote: As mentioned, the photophysics of BODIPY 1 is governed by a reductive photoinduced electron transfer process, from the electron donor aniline to the acceptor BODIPY core, which is therefore reduced upon photoexcitation (Figure 1a).
reference_evidence_units.subject: BODIPY 1
reference_evidence_units.statement: Reductive PET from the meso aniline to the excited BODIPY core.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Builds on the authors' earlier study [16].

reference_evidence_units.quote: rPET leads to the formation of an almost perfectly dark charge transfer excited state
reference_evidence_units.subject: BODIPY 1
reference_evidence_units.statement: rPET populates a dark CT state.

reference_evidence_units.quote: While the nonfluorescent monomer dissipates excitation energy through rPET between the BODIPY core and a meso aniline substituent, J-aggregation in the oligomers enhances radiative decay in nonpolar environments.
reference_evidence_units.subject: BODIPY 1
reference_evidence_units.statement: The monomer is nonfluorescent in polar media.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The emission in 2-MeTHF shows a sharp peak typical of BODIPY dyes,21 together with a weak, redshifted tail that is absent in toluene.
reference_evidence_units.subject: BODIPY 1
reference_evidence_units.statement: A weak red CT tail appears only in the polar solvent.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The shape of the long living component presents the typical spectral features attributed to BODIPY triplet states, signaling the occurrence of intersystem crossing (ISC).31,32
reference_evidence_units.subject: BODIPY 1
reference_evidence_units.statement: A long-lived BODIPY triplet (SOCT-ISC from the CT state).

reference_mechanisms.label: PET_ET
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Nonfluorescent in polar solvents through reductive PET from the meso aniline (dark CT state); emission returns in toluene.

reference_mechanisms.label: TRIPLET_ISC_RTP_TADF
reference_mechanisms.rationale: A BODIPY triplet forms after charge transfer (SOCT-ISC), more in THF than in benzonitrile.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Not discussed for this molecule in the source.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The dark CT state is the product of the rPET itself; not labelled ICT separately (guideline §3.3).

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Nonfluorescent in polar solvents through reductive PET from the meso aniline (dark CT state); emission returns in toluene.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: J-type exciton coupling is the subject for the covalent oligomers, not the monomer.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Not discussed for this molecule in the source.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_ISC_RTP_TADF
mechanism_decisions.rationale: A BODIPY triplet forms after charge transfer (SOCT-ISC), more in THF than in benzonitrile.
